issues.description: The solution's assembleBookstore function declares a parameter (seed: Double) while the problem statement and the template expect an assembleBookstore function with no parameters. Additionally, Client.main() in the solution calls assembleBookstore() with no arguments. This parameter mismatch will cause a compile error in the solution and will confuse students about the expected signature to implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the assembleBookstore signature consistent across artifacts. Either remove the seed parameter from the solution's assembleBookstore (change to private static func assembleBookstore() -> Bookstore) or update the template/problem statement to require a parameter and call assembleBookstore with an appropriate argument in Client.main(). The preferred fix: remove the unused seed parameter in the solution to match the template and problem description.
